phrases.en: Where is the nearest hospital or clinic?
phrases.translated: Dov'è l'ospedale o la clinica più vicina?
phrases.pronunciation: doh-VEH loh-speh-DAH-leh oh lah KLEE-nee-kah pyoo vee-CHEE-nah

phrases.en: Take me to this address, please.
phrases.translated: Mi porti a questo indirizzo, per favore.
phrases.pronunciation: mee POHR-tee ah KWEH-stoh een-dee-REET-zoh, pehr fah-VOH-reh

phrases.en: How much is the fare to the airport?
Where is the nearest train / metro station?
phrases.translated: Dov'è la stazione dei treni / della metropolitana più vicina?
phrases.pronunciation: doh-VEH lah stah-TSYOH-nee day TREH-nee / DEL-lah meh-troh-poh-lee-TAH-nah pyoo vee-CHEE-nah

phrases.en: How do I buy a ticket for this bus/train?
phrases.translated: Come faccio a comprare un biglietto per questo autobus/treno?
phrases.pronunciation: KOH-meh FAH-choh ah kohm-PRAH-reh oon beel-YET-toh per KWEH-stoh OW-toh-boos/TREH-noh

phrases.en: Is this the right platform for the train to [City]?
phrases.translated: È questo il binario giusto per il treno per [Città]?
phrases.pronunciation: eh KWEH-stoh eel bee-NAH-ryoh JOO-stoh per eel TREH-noh per [cheet-TAH]

phrases.en: Do you have this in a larger / smaller size?
phrases.translated: Avete questo in una taglia più grande / piccola?
phrases.pronunciation: ah-VEH-teh KWEH-stoh een oo-nah TAH-lyah pyoo GRAHN-deh / PEEK-koh-lah

phrases.en: Could I have a receipt, please?
phrases.translated: Potrei avere una ricevuta, per favore?
phrases.pronunciation: poh-TRAY ah-VEH-reh oo-nah ree-cheh-VOO-tah, per fah-VOH-reh

phrases.en: Can you write the price down?
Do you have a bag I can buy/use?
phrases.translated: Ha un sacchetto che posso comprare/usare?
phrases.pronunciation: ah oon sahk-KET-toh keh POHS-soh kohm-PRAH-reh/oo-ZAH-reh

phrases.en: Do we pay at the table or at the counter?
phrases.translated: Paghiamo al tavolo o alla cassa?
phrases.pronunciation: pah-GYAH-moh ahl TAH-voh-loh oh AHL-lah KAHS-sah
